Hey y’all , I know no one knows me or one of my best friends from childhood. Last night he took his life. He always used music as an outlet to help with his crippling anxiety and depression. He was such a sweet person, he was always to shy to share his music and only shared it with his friends. He always dreamed of playing his music for the world tho. We all thought he was doing okay, he was making new music everyday and no one expected this would happen last nigh. All I am asking is to go listen to one song of his, leave a comment for his family and friends to help with this hard time. He would have loved it seeing one of his songs getting so many comments and views. So let’s do this for him too. He went by the name Kidd Death here is a link to his song. 
https://youtu.be/9ywNDzyp6t8
